label: Overview
title: How Autobuild works
description: The ticket-driven development lifecycle, its review and verification gates, and the repositories it fits.
headings: From a ticket to a change

label: Getting started
title: Getting started
description: Install Autobuild in your repository, configure it with ab init, validate setup, start the dispatcher, and ask your operator agent for the first change.
headings: 4. Ask your operator agent for the first change

label: Builds
title: One build, end to end
description: Follow a work ticket through planning, review, verification, pull request creation, and merge.
code: spec → plan ⇄ plan-review → implement ⇄ code-review → verify:* → finalize

label: Dispatcher
title: The dispatcher and durable state
description: How Autobuild claims ready tickets, runs isolated builds within capacity, and resumes from its event log.
headings: The log is the source of truth
Resume the work, not the chat

label: Integration
title: Integrating related work
description: Collect work in an integration tree, preserve change identity through restacks, and merge under explicit policy.
code:
bun ab ticket create "Checkout redesign" --body checkout.md --kind node
bun ab ticket create "Cart summary" --body cart.md --target <node-id>

# Leaves merge on the root automatically; everything else needs consent.
[[merge]]
from = "leaf"
into = "root"
mode = "auto"

[[merge]]
mode = "consent"

label: Tickets and specs
title: Tickets and specs
description: How your operator agent writes buildable specs, chooses ticket kinds, and grooms work for the ready gate.
headings: Ready is a gate, not a guarantee

label: Intake and harvest
title: Intake and harvest
description: Turn outside signals and agent observations into reviewed proposals for your operator agent to triage and groom.
code: ab observe --kind followup --files src/retry.ts "Retry budget ignores jitter"

label: Skills
title: Skills
description: Understand Autobuild's agent skills, customize their defaults for your repository, and keep your edits through upgrades.

label: Verification
title: Verification
description: Configure verification gates, understand setup defaults, and collect evidence that your application meets its spec.
code:
[commands]
typecheck = "bun tsc --noEmit"
test = "bun test"

[verify]
steps = ["types", "unit", "acceptance"]

[verify.types]
kind = "check"
command = "typecheck"
always = true

[verify.unit]
kind = "check"
command = "test"

[verify.acceptance]
kind = "agent"
skill = "verify-acceptance"
paths = ["web/**", "src/routes/**"]

[verify]
steps = ["acceptance"]

[verify.acceptance]
kind = "agent"
skill = "verify-acceptance"

[roles.default]
runtime = "codex"
model = "gpt-6.1-sol"

[roles.acceptance]
runtime = "codex"
model = "gpt-6.1-sol"

label: Working with your operator agent
title: Working with your operator agent
description: Delegate specs, tickets, monitoring, and merge to your agent while keeping product decisions and authority with you.
code:
bun ab repository status --json
bun ab watch --operator --json
bun ab answer my-build "Keep the public API compatible"

bun ab pause my-build
bun ab resume my-build

bun ab merge my-build
bun ab hold my-build

label: Seams
title: Infrastructure seams
description: Choose stores, agent runtimes, forges, workspaces, and ticket sources, and understand where local and remote execution run.

label: Configuration
title: Repository configuration
description: Map autobuild.toml settings to verification, agent roles, capacity, ticket readiness, merge policy, and editable skills.
code:
[commands]
typecheck = "bun tsc --noEmit"

[verify]
steps = ["types", "acceptance"]

[verify.types]
kind = "check"
command = "typecheck"
always = true

[verify.acceptance]
kind = "agent"
skill = "verify-acceptance" # repository-authored skill

capacity = 2

[roles.default]
runtime = "claude"

[roles.code-review]
runtime = "pi"
model = "kimi-coding/k3"

[policy]
maxReviewRounds = 6
maxVerifyAttempts = 3
sessionBudgetSeconds = 3600

[accounts.personal]
kind = "claude-subscription"
credentialEnv = "CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN"

[accounts.kimi]
kind = "kimi-code"
credentialEnv = "KIMI_CODE_KEY"
region = "overseas"

[accounts.kimi-china]
kind = "kimi-code"
credentialEnv = "KIMI_CHINA_KEY"
region = "china"

[roles.implement]
runtime = "claude"
account = "kimi"
model = "kimi-for-coding"

bun ab init
bun ab init --validate
